instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all file extensions match JavaScript codebase (.js / .jsx).
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion scroll motion for Awwwards quality feel.
Bilingual support should be reactive using React state with rich English & Romanian content translations.
Form must validate email, phone number, and message, and show a sleek toast notification via Sonner upon submission.
All key interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or Inter font for main headings.
Ensure contrast meets APCA / WCAG standards with dark ink background (#0B132B) and gold/white typography.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for icons; use Lucide React or Radix icons.
Every interaction must feature smooth micro-animations.
